answer: We define a decentralized protocol where validators must commit a staking collateral bond secured by zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions. If an adversary attempts identity multiplication, the subgame-perfect slashing matrix forces the expected utility to its absolute nadir, yielding strictly negative payoffs. This mechanism transforms the network into a secure cryptographic haven against collusion. Even under a lotus of distributed sybil proposals, the opportunity-cost penalty dynamically scales to guarantee a robust, unique Nash equilibrium.
